study_title: Personal light exposure dataset for Izmir, Türkiye
study_preregistration: The study was not preregistered. Analyses were preregistered at https://aspredicted.org/te3zw2.pdf and https://osf.io/7bshp/.
study_ethics: Izmir Institute of Technology Science and Engineering Scientific Research and Publication Ethics Committee, E-41752998-050.04-2400027343
study_short_description: MeLiDos field study data collected by Izmir Institute of Technology (IZTECH).
study_sample: One-participant subset of the MeLiDos IZTECH package for viewer and validation testing.

study_groups.study_group_description: Participants enrolled at the MeLiDos Izmir field site under the study-wide eligibility criteria reported in the MeLiDos preprint (https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.04.730226).
study_group_inclusion: Adults between 18 and 65 years of age
Engaged in full-time employment or part-time employment exceeding 80% workload
study_group_exclusion: Shift work within the preceding two months
Use of medication known to affect photosensitivity
Visual impairments incompatible with the wearable light-monitoring devices
Residence outside the predefined local study region during the recording period
